title: Website rebuild scope
question: The public / page currently looks like a phone app (narrow cream column). What should become a real website?

options.label: Marketing site only (/)
options.thesis: Widen and restructure the public landing into a real website. Leave /app as the phone workout card.
options.viewport: Full-width Society marketing page; /app stays phone-column PT card.
options.risk: Two different shells if the handoff feels abrupt.

options.label: Marketing + soften /app shell
options.thesis: Rebuild / as a real website, and stop framing /app as a fake phone device on desktop.
options.viewport: Wide marketing site; workout usable on desktop without the device chrome.
options.risk: Workout UX still needs phone-first density for training.

options.label: Everything feels like a website
options.thesis: Marketing and workout both abandon the phone-column metaphor for a full web layout.
options.viewport: Desktop-first Society site throughout; phone as responsive, not as the metaphor.
options.risk: Timers and demos can lose focus if the layout gets too wide.
